title: NCR / Kali Yuga — four-city masterplan
provenance: Original fictional NCR-inspired level design. Positions are game coordinates, not surveyed geography. No OSM or third-party map artwork is embedded.

districts.name: Delhi
districts.kit: Painted plaster, shaded arcades, brick service courts, water tanks, local shopfronts

districts.name: Gurugram
districts.kit: Curtain-wall towers, precast podiums, parking decks, planted forecourts, mall service alleys

districts.name: Noida
districts.combat: Grid rotations with controlled long views
districts.kit: Sector blocks, backlot facades, campus walls, green belts, raised wetland walks

districts.name: Ghaziabad
districts.kit: Society towers, painted stair cores, rail sheds, containers, loading courts

pois.name: Ring Bazaar
pois.fight: Three arcaded courtyards feed a circular street fight. Radial alleys break the ring.
pois.routes: Outer service road, covered inner arcade, roof escape; no dominant central firing perch.

pois.name: Metro Interchange
pois.fight: Daylit concourse over a pedestrian metro underpass. Short views change at stair landings.
pois.routes: Two street entrances, two independent stairs, a service exit and a through corridor.

pois.name: Old Lanes
pois.fight: Small homes, courtyards and stepped roofs create close fights with readable escape routes.
pois.routes: Three lane loops; every accessible roof has stairs plus an alternate descent.

pois.name: Civic Gardens
pois.fight: Pavilions, planted berms and low service buildings support slower openings.
pois.routes: Garden edge path, broken wall route and shaded maintenance lane.

pois.name: Glass Quarter
pois.fight: Tower podiums and two selected playable towers offer vertical combat with counters below.
pois.routes: Podium loop, service alleys, two stair cores, roof ascenders and short glider links.

pois.name: Meridian Mall
pois.fight: A shallow two-floor retail loop meets a parking deck and a separate loading court.
pois.routes: Three public doors, two service doors, parking ramps and a roof connection.

pois.name: Fairway Estates
pois.fight: Clubhouse compounds and tree-lined shallow dips turn open ground into short rotations.
pois.routes: Covered estate lane, dry drainage cut and clubhouse flank; no empty fairway sprint.

pois.name: Ridge Workshops
pois.fight: Repair courts and hillside service sheds create a low-density western landing.
pois.routes: Contour path, workshop courtyards and a retained wall route toward Glass Quarter.

pois.name: Sector 18 Grid
pois.fight: Planned blocks alternate occupied facades and green belts, keeping long views interruptible.
pois.routes: Parallel streets, rear courtyards and short roof crossings; cover on both road edges.

pois.name: Film Backlots
pois.fight: Large stages and false-front streets mix exterior lanes with a few deep, well-lit rooms.
pois.routes: Stage doors, exterior backlot loop, loading edge and one visible roof route.

pois.name: Okhla Margins
pois.fight: Raised walks, reed islands and a pump-house compound provide low, broken views.
pois.routes: Two raised paths and a dry embankment; seasonal appearance cannot silently remove exits.

pois.name: Campus Depot
pois.fight: Loading bays, campus walls and a shallow parking deck connect east-side rotations.
pois.routes: Delivery court, courtyard spine and boundary wall breaks; no long fenced dead ends.

pois.name: Rail Freight
pois.fight: Static wagons, staggered containers and two cargo sheds offer ambushes with parallel flanks.
pois.routes: Three longitudinal lanes, cross aisles and an elevated footbridge; train movement comes later.

pois.name: Society Courts
pois.fight: Apartment podiums frame shared courts. Two playable cores connect ground and selected roof decks.
pois.routes: Two court gates, service lane, exterior stairs and a secondary descent on each playable roof.

pois.name: Foundry Blocks
pois.fight: Workshop roofs and industrial loading courts favour lateral movement over one central choke.
pois.routes: Warehouse perimeter, broken service wall and parallel delivery lanes.

pois.name: Vaishali Steps
pois.fight: A terraced metro plaza forms the eastern transfer point, with daylight visible from stairs.
pois.routes: Two plaza approaches, independent station exits and a dry boulevard flank.

crossings.name: North Rail Walk
crossings.counter: Parallel screened walk and two stair exits at each bank.

crossings.name: North Boulevard
crossings.counter: Hard cover islands at 20–30 m intervals; lower maintenance foot route.

crossings.name: Central Interchange
crossings.counter: Split decks, divided approaches and two independently usable ramps.

crossings.name: Southern Causeway
crossings.counter: Screened dry path and secondary boardwalk; protected wetland is scenery.

crossings.name: Blue Underpass
crossings.counter: Two independent exits per bank; fixed pedestrian lane remains usable without trains.

mobility.note: Short ascenders, ziplines and mythic updrafts require implementation. Existing 14 m/s gliding is retained as the design baseline; do not assume unlimited flat-ground gliding.

vertical_slice.required_extensions: One playable metro entrance and a 120 m street connector, inside the slice bounds.
vertical_slice.acceptance: A complete ground-to-roof loop, two paths through each hero building, readable cover, matched Mac/Android collision and measured performance.

streaming.physics_rule: Retain support and authoritative collision independently of visual LOD; query/load coarse projectile cover along the full shot path.
streaming.network_rule: Keep all competitive actors authoritative. Rendering distance never silently suspends remote opponents or drops network updates.

performance_disclaimer: All FPS, memory, geometry and streaming numbers are initial design targets, not measured results or device guarantees. No new game session was launched to produce this plan.
